saw_lines: People buying medicine online want to be sure the pharmacy is real and the product is right before they pay. They reorder the same vitamins and sun care without thinking.
So the sale is decided on the first screen, where a new buyer checks trust, then compares prices.
Your site shows 211 reviews at a 4.4 rating, so open your Google text ads with that number, before a buyer has to click through to the page.
ads_1: Google text ads led by the 4.4 rating and 211 reviews, tested against the price angle
